name: Delusion of Consciousness
body:
School illusion (figment, pattern); Level bard 3, legendary ninja 3, magus 3, medium 3, mesmerist 3, occultist 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (a small prism)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature, see text
Duration concentration, up to 1d6 rounds
Saving Throw Will, see text; Spell Resistance yes, see text

DESCRIPTION

You create flashing lights in the eyes of the target creature rendering them unconscious for 1d6 unless they make a Will save. While the target is unconscious, an image of the target is created which shows them as conscious and active as per the minor image spell. If you cease concentrating on the spell, the image disappears and the unconscious target is revealed.
